title: Teleport Walk (Tpwalk)
features:
Teleport walk known as Tpwalk basically allows you to have a custom walkspeed other than the humanoid walkspeed and it is superior and better and allows for inf speed unlike humanoid walkspeed.

Supports Mobile, Pc, Gamepad devices.
script:
--// Tpwalk
--// Adjust the keybinds to your liking.
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheRealXORA/Roblox/refs/heads/Main/Scripts%20/Universal%20/Tpwalk.luau", true))()
Tpwalk.Keybinds.Tpwalk = "T" or "ButtonA"
Tpwalk.Keybinds.Hide = "H" or "ButtonB"
Tpwalk.Keybinds.Remove = "R" or "ButtonC"
